about_the_game:
A One-on-One Turn-Based Fighting Battle Set in a Casino

Various characters join the brutal showdown for money and glory, stepping into the ring for a high-stakes combat spectacle.

Game System

Each turn, six cards are revealed, each representing an action such as attacking or defending.

Players take turns selecting cards, and characters act in the order their cards were chosen.

Land your attacks skillfully and deplete your opponent’s HP to claim victory!

By betting casino chips on your cards, you can power up your attacks or even set up counters against your opponent.

The more chips you bet, the greater the effect.

Engage in mind games with your opponent and outplay them in this high-stakes battle!
